name: Ramp
text: Add a **large, high-contrast skip link** at the top of every page, visible by default. This lets keyboard users bypass repetitive navigation blocks in one click, solving a core keyboard-nav failure without hiding the tool from sighted users. The trade-off is slightly more screen space used, but the benefit for keyboard-only users outweighs the minimal layout impact.

name: Reader
text: A visible skip link risks pushing down other content, potentially burying crucial elements of the page. This could frustrate users who rely on keyboard navigation as they may find it harder to access important information. A better alternative is using a hidden skip link that becomes visible when focused, ensuring that screen-reader users can still navigate effectively without cluttering the visual layout for sighted users. Settling the argument would involve testing both options with keyboard users to gauge their preferences and usability.
